# Content canaries.
#
# These strings must never appear in a log, dump, crash report, or any other
# diagnostic. They are deliberately distinctive so a leak is obvious.
#
# Two consumers read this file:
#   - `Redactor::canaries()` in crates/curbcut-core/src/redact.rs
#   - scripts/check_no_content_logging.py (CI no-content-logging test)
#
# Add a canary by adding a line. Do not remove one without replacing it, or a
# past leak becomes undetectable.

CC-CANARY-OCR-your-balance-is-12345-67
CC-CANARY-A11Y-ok-got-it
CC-CANARY-PIXEL-00FF00FF
CC-CANARY-REGION-active-region
